$comment: Upload variants. Each is a prefab variant of the root avatar prefab (or of the variant it `extends`) with feature prefabs added as children; `features` lists the ones the generator makes sure are present. Slugs are the names the avatar is uploaded under. `about` is for whoever reads this file and is not sent anywhere. Features whose package is not installed are skipped with a warning. `worstRank` is the worst VRChat performance rank the variant may build to; the checks fail if it ranks lower.

variants.about: Everyday build: default outfit, weighty locomotion, face tracking.
Adventure build: adds flight, a carry seat, a catch-up portal and the hand tools.
The adventure build with a real light source in the flashlight and lantern, which can be left standing in the world. Any light on an avatar ranks it Poor, hence a variant of its own.
